fusions.name: Belated Pounce
fusions.desc: Pounces on a target at or below 25% health, dealing 20 damage and adding 1.2 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it. The health threshold rises with each rank. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Lazy Swat
fusions.desc: A swat that deals 4 damage, knocks the target back 1.5 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Soundless Glide
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Feet Under You
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
